posts.title: Everything takes time (websites)
posts.description: If there's one thing I've learned from making websites since I was 10 years old (so about 25 years now), it's that sites take time. Even in this strange time of one-shot publishing, a good website, one that people want to spend time with and that feels human, takes time.
